response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.healtheval AS status, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.healtheval), stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM grp) SELECT g.site_code, g.status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - st.mean_ratio AS excess FROM grp g CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE g.avg_ratio > st.mean_ratio ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
